The gender gap in life expectancy and health outcomes is influenced by multiple factors.  
- Hormonal differences (A) may contribute to cardiovascular resilience in women.  
- Risky behaviors and occupations (B) are more common among men and increase mortality.  
- Historically, men have had higher smoking rates (C), which affects longevity.  
Since all three factors are documented contributors, the best choice is "All of the above."

Final answer: (D)
